title: Sound Attenuation - Duct split to Terminals
description: Estimating sound attenuation where ducts splits to terminals. Splitting ducts to terminals will reduce the sound power level transferred to each terminal based on the reduced volume of air.

components.content:
## How Sound Attenuation Works

When a duct splits into multiple equal terminals, the sound power level (_LN_) is reduced according to the reduced volume of air flowing through each terminal.

### Formula

The sound attenuation for equal terminals can be calculated as:

**Attenuation (dB) = 10 × log₁₀(Number of Terminals)**

### Example

For a duct that splits into **4 equal terminals**, the sound attenuation from duct to each terminal is approximately **6 dB**.
